citations.quote: SB 884 (Umberg) – Extends the time vote by mail drop off locations are open and modifies the type and range of prohibited activities near a polling location for elections held or proclaimed in 2026, 2027, 2028, and 2029.
Governor Gavin Newsom today signed a package of bills to protect elections in California from interference and political meddling
announced that Governor Gavin Newsom signed Senate Bill 884, the Protect Our Polls Act.
